_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Warrior tracks; resolved family-scoped (Family=4, verified via signature spells: Charge/Heroic Strike/Mortal Strike/Thunder Clap/Shield Wall/Berserker Rage/Battle Stance -> 4; 'Death Stance' does not exist in this build) with the CD-carrier rank pick + companion-shadow rule + uncoded-family fallback (see tools/gen_spell_data.py docstring). Selection policy (same as hunter.json): cooldowns = castable spells whose CooldownMs/CategoryCooldownMs >= 2990 (ForteXorcist 2.99 s floor); buffs = DurationMs > 0 with no cooldown (proc/proc-window, DoT and debuff windows, Cheat Death); stances = the stance toggles (shared 1 s swap category 47, permanent auras) + the shouts (no cooldown in this build: long-duration windows; the CD-bearing shouts Challenging/Intimidating Shout live in cooldowns by the >= 2990 rule); utility = movement/positional tools (Intervene, no CD row in this build). Not listable / not tracked: item set-bonus rows ('S03 - Item - ...', '1.60.0 - Item - Tier 1 - Warrior - ...' -- internal aura rows, not spells), pure passives/talent auras (Improved *, Focused Rage, Tactical Mastery, Warbringer, Wrecking Crew, Annihilation, Frenzied Assault, Consumed By Rage, Flagellation, Vanguard, Vigilance, Booming Voice, Blood Frenzy, Dual Wield Specialization, Lingering Rage, Fresh Meat, Impale, Precise Timing, Taste for Blood companion 427067 -- Enrage and Deep Wounds LEFT this set in Wave I-3 H7, the two are [buffs] rows now), GCD fillers per policy (Heroic Strike, Cleave, Quick Strike, Devastate, Execute (rage dump; its lv-60 row 26651 carries only a 1 s window)) are untracked; Slam IS tracked (18 s category 2412). Devastate (403195/403196, Family 4 + a Family-3 mirror row) carries no window in this build -- it is the Sunder Armor twin (Sunder Armor 11597, 30 s debuff, IS tracked). Forever renames observed vs Classic: Challenger -> Challenging Shout, Intimidation -> Intimidating Shout, Disheartening Shout -> Demoralizing Shout, Crippling Shout -> Cripple, Taunt ranks -> Taunt (category 82 shared with Challenging/Intimidating family per data); Pummel/Concussion Blow/Mocking Blow are the Cata name family. Notable Forever-new warrior spells: Rampage (120 s, Arms execute-adjacent), Rallying Cry (180 s group fear-shrug+heal), Shockwave (20 s stun, category 1201), Meathook (35 s pull), Spearing Strike (20 s), Raging Blow (8 s), Quick Strike (GCD filler, untracked), Battle Forecast / Berserker Forecast / Defensive Forecast (stance-swap proc windows, 15 s), Echoes of Defensive Stance, Gladiator Stance (4th PVP stance, category 47), Commanding Shout (5-min enemy-NPC command), Single-Minded Fury, Sword and Board, Sudden Death (10 s proc), Slammin' (15 s proc), Blood Surge (15 s proc), Gladiator's Cunning, Victorious (20 s), Taste for Blood (9 s proc), Howling Blade (30 s), Deep Wound (12 s), Retaliation (15-min CD) / Retaliate (30 s counter window), Cheat Death (5 s, its 28845 twin is a Family-5 warlock mirror -- filtered by family scoping), Shield Block (5 s block window). Recklessness carries a 30-min cooldown (1800000 ms) in this build. Re-check after each mythicsim-forever-engine pull; run with --dry first. T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1 ruling): NO adds -- all three of the reference's Warrior names (Deep Wounds, Enrage, Vigilance) are proc/passive rows, so they are the _deferred_H7 list and ride with H7 (docs/design-combat-procs.md); the class's counts are unchanged by the wave 2b cut. Wave I-2b (2026-11-03): _deferred_H7 += Reckless Swings (Blizzard dev notes post 9 net-new 15 s talent -- 'NEW talent Reckless Swings, 15 s cd, 8 s window', no client Names row yet, upstream-data §5 row 3). Slam's post-9 15 s cooldown rides tools/overrides_devnotes_2026-11-03.json, NOT this list (the generated row stays a function of the pins). Wave I-3 H7 (2026-11-03, upstream-data §3.1/§7.3, fx-worker I3e): Enrage and Deep Wounds MOVED OUT of _deferred_H7 into [buffs]. Enrage: names.json keys warrior enrage at 12880; the family-4 carrier pair (12880/427066, both DurationMs 12000 -- the store covers both) rides the documented rank ladder and the generator's pick carries the 12 s rage-proc window (upstream-data §3.1 row 10). Deep Wounds: names.json keys warrior deep_wounds at 12834; the family-4 base row + the store's value row (DurationMs 0) resolve -- the window lives on the Mortal Strike/Deep Wounds bleed the AddExtraSpell row of the 2012 reference (docs/class-port.md S15) rides, so THIS row is the id with no bar: a tracked-by-neither pin (Forte_Cooldown/tests/test_tracked_set.lua), the bar arriving with the S15 extra-spell feed. The two kept names: Vigilance (no names.json key -- the 426972 base row is the MoP-era 30-min enabler, its 2026 keying a launch probe) and Reckless Swings (post-9 net-new, not in the store's Names at all -- no id to key, upstream-data §5 row 3).

Berserking.reason: all four 70790 rows (20554/23505/24378/1286304) are value-less name shells (no Cooldowns row), so the bare-row tiebreak rides the arbitrary max-id shell; 20554 is the id measured 180 s on the live client (tools/overrides_devnotes_2026-11-03.json, owner session 2026-11-06; review-10 M2/m4)

Rapid Regeneration.reason: the store's 1260270 is a value-less name shell (no Cooldowns row); the id is pinned to record the measured subject of the 180 s dev-notes fact (tools/overrides_devnotes_2026-11-03.json, owner session 2026-11-06; review-10 M2/m4)
